goal: Protect wallets from data loss and mid-process corruption during legacy-to-SQLite migration
Keep original wallet data intact until the new database is verified
Automatically restore from backup if filesystem or migration errors occur
agreement: Concept support for delaying deletion until migration succeeds (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: copying files risks corruption if a stale SQLite journal exists (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: cleanup removes files while still open, failing on Windows (ryanofsky)
Suggested migrating to an in-memory SQLite database first instead (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it protects user wallet files from being lost or corrupted during migration to SQLite
Failed migrations previously deleted the original database early, requiring manual backup recovery
